name: Entry
note: cartridge entry point: nop; jp $176A

name: Boot
note: the entry jumps here

name: Call_HL
note: jp hl: a call to $0150 calls the routine at HL

name: Call_BC
note: push bc; ret: calls the routine at BC

name: Call_DE
note: push de; ret: calls the routine at DE

name: Far_Jump
note: one-way far jump: A = bank (hFF8B and $2100); jp hl

name: Far_Call
note: far call: B = bank; pushes the caller's bank; the callee returns through jp $0173

name: Far_CallKeepA
note: far call keeping A through hFF8A: B = bank; HL = target

name: Far_Return
note: pops the caller's bank; switches back; ret

name: Far_ReturnSramBank
note: return restoring a bank read from the stack (SRAM routines)

name: JumpTable_ByA
note: jump to word A of the table at HL

name: JumpTable_Inline
note: jump to word A of the table that follows the call

name: FarJumpTable_ByA
note: far call of record A of the {lo; hi; bank} table at HL through $015B

name: Mode_Set
note: mode = A (hFF8D)

name: State_Set
note: state = A (hFF8E)

name: ModeState_Set
note: mode = B; state = C

name: ModeState_SetInline
note: mode and state from the two bytes after the call

name: Copy_Inline
note: copy with inline {source; destination; count} after the call

name: Copy_DEtoHL
note: copy BC bytes from DE to HL

name: Copy_FarInline
note: copy with inline {source; bank; destination; count} after the call

name: Copy_FarDEtoHL
note: copy BC bytes from DE in bank A to HL

name: Lcd_SetupInline
note: 11 inline bytes: LCDC; BGP; OBP0; OBP1; SCY; SCX; WY; WX; -; STAT; IE

name: Lcd_SetupInlineNoIE

name: Vram_CopyHBlank

name: Vram_CopyHBlankFar

name: Lcdc_SetCallbackNext

name: Lcdc_SetCallback

name: Serial_SetFarCallback

name: Object_Create

name: Object_RunAll

name: ScriptSlots_Clear
note: empties the 6 script slots of 20 bytes at $DC67 (the record book calls it on entry: BGB writes 01:5975/5976 at every visit)

name: ScriptSlots_Add

name: ScriptSlots_Run
note: runs one step of each busy slot of $DC67 (far called from banks 0 and 7)

name: RecordBook_CountHundreds

name: RecordBook_CountTens
note: flowers of the second kind: the tens digit of hFFEA

name: RecordBook_CountUnits

note: slot script shared by the 5 vines: waits, then grows the hundreds, tens and units flowers one by one

name: RecordBook_VineTaken
